facts.text: The hotel is in Tempe's newly revitalized downtown, within a five-minute walk of Arizona State University's Tempe campus.
facts.excerpt: Situated in Tempe’s newly revitalized downtown and located within a five-minute walk of Arizona State University's Tempe campus

facts.text: The hotel has an expansive rooftop pool deck with views of the city.
facts.excerpt: unwind on the expansive rooftop pool deck or have drinks at our rooftop lounge amid views of the city

facts.text: The rooftop pool has private cabanas.
facts.excerpt: Soak in the sun poolside in a private cabana or savor a bite at Salt & Gila at our rooftop pool experience.

facts.text: The new guest rooms and suites blend modern comfort and amenities with Southwest style.
facts.excerpt: New guest rooms and suites are a cool contrast to the Sonoran desert landscape, blending modern comfort and amenities with Southwest style.

facts.text: The 24-hour fitness center is equipped with Peloton bikes and StairClimbers.
facts.excerpt: Keep up with your workout routine in our 24-hour fitness center, fully equipped with Peloton bikes, StairClimbers and more.

facts.text: Within five minutes' walk of the hotel, guests can hike A Mountain, run along Tempe Town Lake or explore live music venues.
facts.excerpt: Within five minutes walking of the hotel, hike iconic A Mountain, take a morning run along Tempe Town Lake, or explore live music venues all outside our front door.

facts.text: The hotel is a base for boutique shopping on Mill Avenue and hiking trails at Papago Park and Tempe Butte.
facts.excerpt: from boutique shopping on Mill Avenue to hiking scenic trails at Papago Park and Tempe Butte

facts.text: Dining includes a full-service restaurant, a coffee shop, a rooftop bar and a pool bar and grill.
facts.excerpt: Four dining outlets - one full-service restaurants, a coffee shop, a rooftop bar and a pool bar & grill

facts.text: The American restaurant serves farm-fresh ingredients and craft cocktails.
facts.excerpt: an American restaurant serving farm-fresh ingredients and craft cocktails

facts.text: The hotel is pet friendly, accepting dogs only.
facts.excerpt: Omni Tempe Hotel at ASU is a pet-friendly hotel.

facts.text: Parking is valet only; self-parking is not available.
Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport is 4.1 miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX) is 4.1 miles from the hotel (approximately 9 minutes).

facts.text: The hotel has nearly 36,000 square feet of event space for weddings and events.
facts.excerpt: With nearly 36,000 square feet of event space, we also offer an exceptional setting for weddings, events, and gatherings of all kinds.

facts.text: The hotel has a Presidential Suite.
The hotel is located steps from ASU's Tempe campus on University Drive and Mill Ave.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel is located steps from ASU Tempe campus on University Drive and Mill Ave.

facts.text: The hotel is AAA Four Diamond-rated.
facts.excerpt: Experience the best of Arizona at the AAA Four Diamond-rated Omni Tempe Hotel.
